systems.platform: paper questionnaire, then SurveyCTO (CAPI) on Android tablets, data downloaded in Stata format
systems.owner: MBSSE EMIS department, Directorate of Planning and Policy; supported by GPE, the World Bank and EU-SESSiL
systems.tiers: all 12,168 schools, pre-primary to senior secondary, in 16 districts; in July 2021 head teachers and principals filled paper questionnaires, which quality assurance officers collected for district IT officers to key in; 624 senior secondary principals were trained and given tablets to submit their own return; digital collection since 2018

systems.owner: MBSSE Directorate of Planning and Policy
systems.tiers: the department that runs the census and the source of the report's data; each school carries an EMIS number; no entry by schools other than the yearly return is described

systems.platform: website built by the Directorate of Science, Technology and Innovation
systems.tiers: set up in 2019 on the 2018 census data; a public repository and visualisation of census figures; census data from 2015 digitised and linked with Fab Inc

note: An excerpt of a census report (capture truncated): it describes the yearly return and nothing schools enter between censuses, so every system is census and no fact is taken.
